definitions.explanation: A rhythmic pattern in Japanese poetry where lines alternate between five and seven morae (syllable units). This meter forms the foundation of traditional Japanese verse forms including tanka and haiku.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: Haiku is based on the five-seven meter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The five-seven rhythm feels natural in the Japanese language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{万葉集|まんようしゅう}→万葉集：08827_manyoushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詠|よ}まれて→詠む：14186_yomu⟧おり、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Many poems in the Man'yoshu are composed in five-seven meter, which has become a fundamental rhythm of Japanese literature.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧ (five), {七|しち} (seven), and {調|ちょう} (rhythm, meter). The five-seven pattern is deeply embedded in Japanese prosody. It appears not only in classical poetry but also in modern slogans, proverbs, and song lyrics.

POETIC FORMS USING THIS METER:
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧: 5-7-5 morae
- ⟦{短歌|たんか}→短歌：15358_tanka⟧: 5-7-5-7-7 morae
- ⟦{川柳|せんりゅう}→川柳：09660_senryuu⟧: 5-7-5 morae (humorous)
- {都々逸|どどいつ}: 7-7-7-5 morae (popular song form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧: five-seven rhythm
- {五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詠|よ}む→詠む：14186_yomu⟧: to compose in five-seven meter
- {五七調|ごしっちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧: to set to five-seven meter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{七五調|しちごちょう}→七五調：29157_shichigochou⟧: seven-five meter — the reverse pattern, starting with seven morae; has a more flowing, prose-like feel
- {韻律|いんりつ}: meter, prosody — the general concept of rhythmic patterns in verse
- ⟦{定型|ていけい}→定型：12349_teikei⟧: fixed form — the concept of standardized poetic structures
